As the petitioner/injured remained admitted for 13 days and considering his period of hospitalization as well as nature of injury, it is assumed that the victim was incapacitated from working for at least 2 months.
Hence, compensation for two months of salary can be awarded towards loss of income.
Accordingly, Rs.26,693X2= Rs.53,386/- is awarded towards loss of income.
Since the injury has not resulted in any disability no compensation towards loss of future can be granted.
